items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: There are three strong guys on that band -- Herman Flowers, you and Leroy Cooper.

ctx.x: There are three strong guys on that band -- Herman Flowers, you and Leroy Cooper. The others could be a bit...

Yeah. See, we didn't have very good musicians living around here, and I kept the same boys all the time. I didn't care if they wasn't no outstanding musicians. I'd write according to their ability. In fact, for the whole band, because I didn't put nothin' too stiff where they couldn't play. Better for them to play something...
